name: Podman Remote Client
description: Installs the Podman CLI and configures it to talk to the host's Podman socket (Docker-outside-of-Docker). Binds the host podman.sock into the container at /tmp/podman.sock and sets CONTAINER_HOST so podman commands run containers on the host. The socket path is a host bind mount, so a host that uses a non-default location must override this feature's mount in devcontainer.json.

hostSocketPath.description: Path of the host Podman socket this feature declares as a bind mount (sourced to /tmp/podman.sock). Override the mount in devcontainer.json if your host uses a non-default location.
